brief_rationale: The doctor systematically addressed all 8 responsibility-chain items with no omission or commission error. RC1–RC8 are all met. The trajectory actively completed three high-order points (HO1 cross-institution document workflow, HO2 safe bounded closure with unresolved-risk classification, and HO3 verification of low-quality/blurry evidence) with meaningful trajectory impact. No important non-chain defect is present. Closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid. This satisfies Strong with two independently completed HOs (HO1 and HO2), but HO3 is also complete, qualifying for Perfect under the non-overlap rule (two HOs required for Perfect, but three are present and none invalidates).
